title: Final Answer A
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for A must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Final Answer T
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the transmission coefficient T must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Wavefunction Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The wavefunction must be correctly formulated for both regions x < 0 and x > 0.

title: Coefficient Matching
description: Important Criteria: The matching of coefficients between the wavefunction expressions must be correctly executed.

title: Integration Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The integration steps for k(x) and the subsequent calculations should be clearly shown.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include sign mistakes in the wavefunction or coefficients.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
